title: Prospective Causal-Field Failure Decomposition, Engine-Conditional Context Geometry, Search-Topology Context Instrumentation, Counterexample-Guided Schema Evolution, Fresh Reconstitution, Held-Out Regime Transport & Reproducible Explanation-Service API

parent_authority.boundary: P2 discovery-minimal B3 field was target-blind scoped over 68.75% of held-out profiles but produced 8 contradictions and 1 mixed cell.

may_do: freeze two P2-derived legacy-surface 5-coordinate rival schemas as non-authoritative fresh controls
may_not_do: alter thresholds after P3 target opening
promote a P2-derived legacy-surface rival into the primary P3 field

formal_object.context_schema: One prospectively frozen semantic family over pre-intervention parent-trace structure

context_measurement.timing: At or before the candidate event in the unablated parent semantic-use trace; EVENT_PREFIX_ONLY. No next-event, future same-key, or symmetric-window feature is admitted.
forbidden_primary: future same-key reuse after the candidate
any symmetric trace window containing post-candidate events
context_measurement.key_equality_definition: Use P32 parent-trace field `key` transiently to derive equality/reuse counts within indices <= candidate ordinal; raw key bytes/values are never emitted.

corpus.selection: Unique legal FENs sorted by SHA-256(FEN); exclude every P1/P2 position hash; first eight remaining positions; three hash-ordered non-target decoys per target; no engine outcomes.

discovery_court.selection_rule: minimum added-coordinate count, then frozen schema rank, then lexical schema id
discovery_court.development_rival_rule: LEGACY_SURFACE_5A/5B receive the same fresh discovery metrics as falsification controls but are never eligible for primary selection, engine-specific selection, support gates, or P3 PASS.

heldout_transport_gate.global: Every covered profile agrees with discovery label and no covered mixed target cell exists.
heldout_transport_gate.engine_specific: Per-engine selected fields are target-blind scoped and verified. If all three certify while the pooled global field is absent or fails, the allowed result is ENGINE_CONDITIONAL_FIELDS_SUPPORTED_CROSS_ENGINE_GLUE_HOLD; engine identity remains an index, not a causal coordinate.
heldout_transport_gate.abstention: Unseen cells are excluded from error counts and remain explicit abstentions.

explanation_service.implementation: deterministic HTTP/JSON service; no LLM dependency
explanation_service.parity_requirement: Service query statuses must match Rust c3x-field-p3 query on the same profile packet.
explanation_service.future_adapters: MCP/agent/LLM narrator may wrap the service but cannot expand certificate authority.

verdict_ladder.rule: Apply mechanically after fresh discovery and held-out opening. If no global schema exists but all three prospectively selected engine-specific fields pass their held-out scope and transport gates, emit ENGINE_CONDITIONAL_FIELDS_SUPPORTED_CROSS_ENGINE_GLUE_HOLD rather than a generic no-global-field HOLD.

claim_ceiling: Primary topology context is event-prefix-only: no baseline event occurring after the candidate may enter a primary P3 context cell.
P2 contradictions are development-only and cannot certify P3.
A schema family is an operational licensing language for ROOT_CHANGE, not a unique true causal ontology.
Key-equality topology is relational parent-trace structure; raw key identity is not admitted.
Engine-specific field differences do not establish engine architecture as the causal source.
Unseen contexts imply abstention, not non-causality.
No authority beyond frozen source commits, books, history procedure, search budget and engines.
No cognition, intent, human strategy, or population-prevalence claim.
The deterministic explanation service cannot add authority beyond its bundled field certificates.
Fresh success of a development-derived legacy-surface rival is descriptive only and cannot produce the P3 primary verdict.

development_derived_rivals.origin: Post-hoc minimum-cardinality collision-free basis on pooled P2 discovery+held-out records; frozen before any P3 selective outcome.
